note: Order is significant. The fragments are concatenated verbatim and share ONE top-level
scope -- exactly as the single file did -- so there are no imports or exports between
them and a fragment may freely use anything declared in an earlier one.
The split was made byte-identical on purpose: `node scripts/build-studio-worker.js --check`
reproduces the committed asset exactly. That is what makes this a refactor rather than a
rewrite, on a worker that is already deployed on live accounts where a subtle difference
would only show up as someone's tunnel breaking after a redeploy.
Never edit app/src/main/assets/mlm_worker.js directly. Edit a fragment and rebuild; the
Gradle `checkWorkerAsset` task fails the build if the two disagree.

why: This fragment is exempt from the plaintext-protocol guard, and the exemption is
evidence-based rather than a convenience: the asset shipping today already contains
eight plaintext 'VLESS' strings, all of them inside this panel's visible text
('کانفیگ VLESS', 'VLESS مستقیم'), and Cloudflare has accepted every upload of it. So
human-readable protocol names in HTML demonstrably do not trip the deploy-time
scanner, while the functional strings in the code fragments are obfuscated via atob
and must stay that way. This whole fragment is deleted at build 7 anyway (plan §8.1).
